DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced parkinsonism secondary to risperidone.

The patient is a 23-year-old male diagnosed with schizophrenia who started risperidone two months ago and reports improved psychiatric symptoms. Given his age and the timing of the medication initiation, the new onset movement disorder is highly suggestive of a side effect from the antipsychotic. I will need to assess the specific type of movement and consider imaging to rule out other causes like neuroleptic malignant syndrome or structural lesions, but based on the clinical presentation, this is the most likely diagnosis.
